record.reason: The primary source states that FoMoE partitions expert layers across workers and skips non-resident experts during local training; its stated target is cross-site MoE training over constrained WAN links (abstract and §1). The reported communication reductions and skip-token throughput gains are training-system outcomes; §6 separates trained proxy quality runs and measured training throughput from modeled larger-scale results. §7 says XL/XXL and 100B-scale results are projections rather than end-to-end pretraining runs, and that the evaluation is controlled around homogeneous workers and synchronous rounds.
record.title: FoMoE: Breaking the Full-Replica Barrier with a Federation of MoEs
